The '''Weik system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within, [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]], a region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that had not been throroughly explored or mapped by the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It had at least one [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Weik]].<ref name="NoP" />
